top_signals.title: Yen Traders Use Options for ‘Flexibility’ Into US Inflation Data
top_signals.summary: Yen traders are ramping up options market activity ahead of key US inflation data, turning to derivatives for flexibility amid a lack of consensus on the currency’s direction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Rakuten’s Shares Plunge After Mobile Losses Fuel Investor Fears
top_signals.summary: Rakuten Group Inc.’s shares sank the most in over a year after the Japanese e-commerce pioneer failed to slash persisting losses at its mobile unit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ravencoin hits record low as network exploit puts transactions at risk
top_signals.summary: Mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hash rate are building a competing chain that could trigger a three-day reorganization.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
